issues.description: The Lecture constructor signature in the template does not match the UML/problem description and the solution: the template provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents) while the UML and solution expect a constructor that initializes five attributes in this order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This discrepancy can confuse students about the required constructor signature and the expected parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template constructor signature to match the UML and solution by including all five parameters in the specified order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, remove the incomplete constructor from the template so students implement the required constructor themselves as described in the task.
